name: Minute Maid Blue Raspberry
nf: I spotted this at CVS a few days ago, and had been looking for it for awhile. I like the Minute Maid Blue Raspberry slushie at McDonald’s (since rebranded to Fanta) so I figured I would like the drink version as much or better. I’m sorry to say I did not like it as much and in fact most of the energy drinks with blue raspberry flavor on this list taste much better. I couldn’t even really detect a true blue raspberry flavor in there at all. Sad!

name: Mountain Dew Liberty Chill
msl: I don’t really even drink regular mountain dew.  I used to drink it when I was in HS.  This tastes a little blue, but nothing to truly write home about.  LESS IS MORE, MOUNTAIN DEW!!!!! WHAT IF THIS WAS 1 FLAVOR INSTEAD OF 49 EXTRA??? Anyway it tastes kinda like a flat blue drink, I don’t know lol.  It’s alright.  Not bad.  Not great.  Just OK.
nf: This is described as “Liberty Chill is 50 Flavors in one flavored Mountain Dew.” That sounds right because it tastes like regular ass Mountain Dew with a bunch of other flavoring on top of it. I am much more of a Diet Dew and Zero Sugar Dew guy, partially because of the less sugar thing but I think they really do taste much better. I was a big fan of last year’s Summer Freeze bomb pop flavor (shocking, I know. I do think that kinda led to this whole thing), but this is just kinda flat. BRING BACK SUMMER FREEZE!!

name: Mountain Dew Star-Spangled Banner
msl: I’m not a dew-head.  But I’m gonna drink this. I gotta say when the liquid hit my lips and filled my mouth - I was digging it, but the second I went to actually swallow it it felt like the flavor just SAPPED and went FLAT.  I don’t really know what type of red berry this is, but it aint very strong the second it settles.  Honestly, the more sips I take the less I kinda enjoy the flavor.  It’s just…not great.  Yeah I dunno.  Not my favorite, that’s for dang sure.  Good for the first few seconds of the sip, and then bad when you swallow.
nf: I’m also not a Dew-head in terms of standard Dew. I love Diet Dew and like Zero Sugar. I think they taste notably different and better than the regular versions. I am also fairly new to flavored Dews. I’ve only had Summer Freeze (loved it), Voltage (eh), and the previously tested Liberty Chill. This is “Dew with a blast of Red Berry flavor with other natural flavors.” …Well, it’s ok. Almost tastes vaguely alcoholic. I can detect the regular Dew and the red berry flavors a bit, but they don’t really go well together IMO. Diet Dew continues to reign supreme.

name: Coca‑Cola Oreo Zero Sugar
msl:
I’ve been wanting to try this for weeks now. Was very excited to see it in the fridge when getting home from work. Let’s freaking gooo!!! OREO COKE ZERO!!!

So first things, smells just like Oreo. Second things - it tastes…odd. NF’s immediate thought of “vanilla” sounds right, though I do get the hint of COOKIE flavoring as it’s going down my throat. I almost psyched myself into thinking it was actual oreo cookie crumbs in here for a second. There’s a sweet taste, but it’s not really that sweet. It just kinda tastes a bit like a watered down coke. Sloshing it around the mouth I get much more of a “cookie is in my mouth” feeling, but when most people are drinking a soda they generally aren’t sloshing it around the mouth. This is fine. This isn’t UTTERLY DISGUSTING like I thought it might be when I first saw it announced. I’m glad I tried it. Prob won’t get it again though. Fun little gimmick.
nf:
Well I found this at Walgreens, but my attempts to also find Mountain Dew VooDew came up empty. I have heard mixed things for this bizarre mix. I will see if I can find the cookies as well.

Kinda tastes like vanilla Coke Zero. Maybe a little different, but that’s basically the flavor I’m getting. It’s enjoyable - especially since you can’t find vanilla Coke Zero outside of the Freestyle fountains or 12 packs - but not exactly all that different. It’s probably a different formula, but would I be shocked if they slapped the Oreo name on some Vanilla Coke Z to juke some gimmick sales? No. No I wouldn’t.

name: A&W Ice Cream Sundae Zero Sugar
msl:
I just got my teeth cleaned and polished and told basically to get on some damn invisiline so how about that. Let’s ruin it with some ICE CREAM SUNDAE. This is A&W. It looks brown like root beer. It smells exactly like fudge on a hot fudge sundae. Let’s give this a go.

It’s creamy, and then you get hit with a bit of aftertaste that I’m not so sure is the most pleasant. I like it in the first half, less so in the second. The aftertaste it leaves on the inside of your cheeks, it’s odd. You’re mostly tasting the hot fudge flavor, but it’s diluted. I kinda like it / don’t hate it. I can see myself definitely drinking more of this especially because NF has an entire 12 pack. Very curious what the sugar version of this would taste like. I feel like it might help the flavor and pack a better punch. Thumbs in the middle drink. Thanks for the fun A&W
nf:
Matt is back from his abandonment of me vacation, so we are going to do a two-fer today. Or maybe a one point fiver. I first caught whiff of this limited edition A&W flavor ages ago. Maybe January, maybe even last year. It’s been announced for awhile. Ideally I would have found two 20 oz. bottles of the non-diet (ahem, “zero sugar” because men are fragile little pussydilliaci babymen) but I have settled for a 12 pack of the zero sugar. As I have 11 more cans of this, I pray this isn’t dogshit.

Tastes like chocolate soda. A little cream in there for the “ice cream” part, but this is really is mostly chocolate soda. I’m not going nuts for it, but as a little diversion it’s fine enough. I can see myself accompanying a meal or two with this. There is an odd chemical flavoring on subsequent sips that is putting me off a bit. That’s odd because A&W products are generally pretty good even in zero sugar form, so maybe they weren’t able to get a good chocolate flavor without it. I am kinda wishing I’d just gotten the full sugar one now, but it’s not terrible. Worth a try if you see a 20 oz bottle, I suppose.
